Source.Name: wayland-pipewire-idle-inhibit
Source.Summary: Inhibit Wayland idle state when audio is playing via PipeWire
Source.Description: Small utility that monitors PipeWire for active audio playback and automatically inhibits Wayland idle management systems to prevent screen dimming or lock.
